description: Get facts for a Azure specific Traffic Manager profile or all Traffic Manager profiles.

parameters.name: ad_user
parameters.description: Active Directory username. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: adfs_authority_url
parameters.description: Azure AD authority url. Use when authenticating with Username/password, and has your own ADFS authority.

parameters.name: api_profile
parameters.description: Selects an API profile to use when communicating with Azure services. Default value of latest is appropriate for public clouds; future values will allow use with Azure Stack. Default: "latest"

parameters.name: auth_source
parameters.description: Controls the source of the credentials to use for authentication. Can also be set via the ANSIBLE_AZURE_AUTH_SOURCE environment variable. When set to auto (the default) the precedence is module parameters -> env -> credential_file -> cli. When set to env, the credentials will be read from the environment variables When set to credential_file, it will read the profile from ~/.azure/credentials. When set to cli, the credentials will be sources from the Azure CLI profile. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if more than one is present otherwise the default az cli subscription is used. When set to msi, the host machine must be an azure resource with an enabled MSI extension. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if the resource is granted access to more than one subscription, otherwise the first subscription is chosen. The msi was added in Ansible 2.6. Choices: "auto" ← (default) "cli" "credential_file" "env" "msi"

parameters.name: cert_validation_mode
parameters.description: Controls the certificate validation behavior for Azure endpoints. By default, all modules will validate the server certificate, but when an HTTPS proxy is in use, or against Azure Stack, it may be necessary to disable this behavior by passing ignore. Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CERT_VALIDATION environment variable. Choices: "ignore" "validate"

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Azure client ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal or Managed Identity (msi). Can also be set via the AZURE_CLIENT_ID environment variable.

parameters.name: cloud_environment
parameters.description: For cloud environments other than the US public cloud, the environment name (as defined by Azure Python SDK, eg, AzureChinaCloud, AzureUSGovernment), or a metadata discovery endpoint URL (required for Azure Stack). Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT environment variable. Default: "AzureCloud"

parameters.name: disable_instance_discovery
parameters.description: Determines whether or not instance discovery is performed when attempting to authenticate. Setting this to true will completely disable both instance discovery and authority validation. This functionality is intended for use in scenarios where the metadata endpoint cannot be reached such as in private clouds or Azure Stack. The process of instance discovery entails retrieving authority metadata from https://login.microsoft.com/ to validate the authority. By setting this to **True**, the validation of the authority is disabled. As a result, it is crucial to ensure that the configured authority host is valid and trustworthy. Set via credential file profile or the AZURE_DISABLE_INSTANCE_DISCOVERY environment variable. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: log_mode
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: log_path
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Limit results to a specific Traffic Manager profile.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Active Directory user password. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Security profile found in ~/.azure/credentials file.

parameters.name: resource_group
parameters.description: The resource group to search for the desired Traffic Manager profile.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: Azure client secret. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: subscription_id
parameters.description: Your Azure subscription Id.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Limit results by providing a list of tags. Format tags as ‘key’ or ‘key:value’.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: Azure tenant ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: thumbprint
parameters.description: The thumbprint of the private key specified in x509_certificate_path. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal. Required if x509_certificate_path is defined.

parameters.name: x509_certificate_path
parameters.description: Path to the X509 certificate used to create the service principal in PEM format. The certificate must be appended to the private key. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

examples:
- name: Get facts for one Traffic Manager profile
  azure_rm_trafficmanager_info:
    name: Testing
    resource_group: myResourceGroup

- name: Get facts for all Traffic Manager profiles
  azure_rm_trafficmanager_info:

- name: Get facts by tags
  azure_rm_trafficmanager_info:
    tags:
      - Environment:Test

return_values.name: tms
return_values.description: List of Traffic Manager profiles. Returned: always

return_values.name: allowed_endpoint_record_types
return_values.description: The list of allowed endpoint record types. Returned: always Sample: ["None"]

return_values.name: dns_config
return_values.description: The DNS settings of the Traffic Manager profile. Returned: always

return_values.name: fqdn
return_values.description: The fully-qualified domain name(FQDN) of the Traffic Manager profile. Returned: always Sample: "testTm.trafficmanager.net"

return_values.name: relative_name
return_values.description: The relative DNS name provided by the Traffic Manager profile. Returned: always Sample: "testTm"

return_values.name: ttl
return_values.description: The DNS Time-To-Live(TTL), in seconds. Returned: always Sample: 60

return_values.name: endpoints
return_values.description: The list of endpoints in the Traffic Manager profile. Returned: always

return_values.name: geo_mapping
return_values.description: The list of countries/regions mapped to this endpoint when the profile has routing_method geographic. Returned: always Sample: ["GEO-NA", "GEO-AS"]

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: Fully qualified resource ID for the resource. Returned: always Sample: "/subscriptions/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx/resourceGroups/myResourceGroup/providers/Microsoft.Network/trafficMan agerProfiles/tmtest/externalEndpoints/e1"

return_values.name: location
return_values.description: The location of endpoints when type=external_endpoints or type=nested_endpoints, and profile routing_method=performance. Returned: always Sample: "East US"

return_values.name: min_child_endpoints
return_values.description: The minimum number of endpoints that must be available in the child profile to make the parent profile available. Returned: always Sample: 3

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The name of the endpoint. Returned: always Sample: "e1"

return_values.name: priority
return_values.description: The priority of this endpoint when the profile has routing_method=priority. Returned: always Sample: "3"

return_values.name: status
return_values.description: The status of the endpoint. Returned: always Sample: "Enabled"

return_values.name: target
return_values.description: The fully-qualified DNS name of the endpoint. Returned: always Sample: "8.8.8.8"

return_values.name: target_resource_id
return_values.description: The Azure Resource URI of the of the endpoint. Returned: always Sample: "/subscriptions/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx/resourceGroups/myResourceGroup/providers/Microsoft.ClassicCompute/dom ainNames/vscjavaci"

return_values.name: type
return_values.description: The type of the endpoint. Returned: always Sample: "external_endpoints"

return_values.name: weight
return_values.description: The weight of this endpoint when the profile has routing_method=weighted. Returned: always Sample: 10

return_values.name: max_return
return_values.description: Maximum number of endpoints to be returned for MultiValue routing type. Returned: always Sample: 10

return_values.name: monitor_config
return_values.description: The endpoint monitoring settings of the Traffic Manager profile. Returned: always

return_values.name: custom_headers
return_values.description: List of custom headers. Returned: always Sample: [{"name": "key1", "value": "value1"}, {"name": "key2", "value": "value2"}]

return_values.name: expected_status_code_ranges
return_values.description: List of expected status code ranges. Returned: always Sample: [{"max": 205, "min": 200}, {"max": 222, "min": 211}]

return_values.name: interval
return_values.description: The monitor interval for endpoints in this profile in seconds. Returned: always Sample: 10

return_values.name: path
return_values.description: The path relative to the endpoint domain name used to probe for endpoint health. Returned: always Sample: "/"

return_values.name: port
return_values.description: The TCP port used to probe for endpoint health. Returned: always Sample: 80

return_values.name: protocol
return_values.description: The protocol HTTP, HTTPS or TCP used to probe for endpoint health. Returned: always Sample: "HTTP"

return_values.name: timeout
return_values.description: The monitor timeout for endpoints in this profile in seconds. Returned: always Sample: 30

return_values.name: tolerated_failures
return_values.description: The number of consecutive failed health check before declaring an endpoint Degraded after the next failed health check. Returned: always Sample: 3

return_values.name: profile_status
return_values.description: The status of the Traffic Manager profile. Returned: always Sample: "Enabled"

return_values.name: resource_group
return_values.description: Name of a resource group where the Traffic Manager profile exists. Returned: always Sample: "testGroup"

return_values.name: routing_method
return_values.description: The traffic routing method of the Traffic Manager profile. Returned: always Sample: "performance"

return_values.name: state
return_values.description: The state of the Traffic Manager profile. Returned: always Sample: "present"
